geodata: none: lights are placed in the aircraft model frame under the drawn body's object transform

aircraft.kind: fictional shuttle (backend RegionalFlight.kt), no real type documentation
aircraft.modelFrame: metres; +z forward, +y up (gear contact y = 0), +x = aircraft's left (left = up x forward)
aircraft.worldTransform: airplane.matrixWorld: smoothed position, rotation (-pitch, heading, bank, 'YXZ'), scale 1/25 (scene units of 25 m)

sources.title: EASA Easy Access Rules for Large Aeroplanes (CS-25), CS 25.1385 (b), (c) Position light system installation
sources.used: red left, green right, white rear (as far aft as practicable)

sources.title: CS 25.1387 (b)-(d) Position light system dihedral angles
sources.used: L and R 110 deg from dead ahead; A bounded by planes 70 deg left and right of dead astern

sources.title: CS 25.1395 Maximum intensities in overlapping beams of position lights
sources.used: bounds only: no limit in the first 10 deg beyond a boundary; red/green capped at 10 cd (10-20 deg, Area A) and 1 cd (beyond, Area B)

sources.title: CS 25.1401 (b)-(d) Anti-collision light system
sources.used: aviation red or white; effective flash frequency 40-100 cycles per minute (range for the estimated periods)

sources.title: SERA.3215 Lights to be displayed by aircraft, Reg. (EU) No 923/2012 as amended by (EU) 2016/1185 (EASA Easy Access Rules for SERA)
sources.license: EU legislation / EASA public regulatory material
sources.used: (a) night in flight; (b)(1), (b)(4) movement area at night; (c), (d) by day; (e) pilot may switch off or dim flashing lights. No rule for landing or taxi lights.

sockets_m.basis: ESTIMATE read from the drawn model (transportModels.ts)

estimates.positionLightOverlap: ESTIMATE: 100 % to 8 deg beyond a boundary, ramp to 10 % at 10 deg, 10 % to 18 deg, ramp to 0 at 20 deg (within CS 25.1395)

beaconFlash.pattern: single pulse; top and bottom together

estimates.flashPhase: FNV-1a 32-bit hash of id + '|beacon' or '|strobe', as a fraction of the period (deterministic, not real data)

simulatorRule.note: simulator rule informed by SERA.3215, not an airline SOP; taxi light only with the gear down; unknown phases: navigation and beacon

clock: simulation time from the backend snapshots (10 per real second), interpolated at the time scale, max 0.25 real s ahead, held when paused, monotonic except after a reset; each frame shows the on-share of its simulation-time window
